title: The Beverly Hillbillies
description: A backwoods family strikes oil and moves to a Beverly Hills mansion, baffling their banker and his high-society neighbors.
credits: Created by Paul Henning · Starring Buddy Ebsen, Irene Ryan, Donna Douglas, Max Baer Jr., Raymond Bailey, Nancy Kulp · Filmways TV Productions

rights.notes: Only Season 1 (all 36 episodes, 1962-63) and Season 2 episodes 1-19 (through 'The Race for Queen', aired 1964-02-05) are public domain: their 28th-year renewals were due 1990-1992 and were never filed. PRIMARY-SOURCE CHECK (2026-09-26): the Copyright Office online records show Orion's Filmways renewals starting with S2E20 'Lafe Returns' (orig. LP28481, 1964-02-12; RE0000573927, filed 1992-02-18) and running through later episodes; no renewal exists for any 1962-63 episode, and exact-title searches for every episode listed here returned no renewal. Consistent with Wikipedia ('Fifty-five episodes ... all 36 Season 1 episodes and 19 Season 2 episodes ... Orion Television ... neglected to renew'). MUSIC RISK (must act): the theme 'The Ballad of Jed Clampett' was separately renewed as a musical composition (RE0000491061 etc., 1990-05-17, claimant Carolintone Music), so it is under copyright until ~2057 even though the episode film is PD; the Flatt & Scruggs recording is a pre-1972 sound recording protected federally (Music Modernization Act) until 2067. Replace/mute the opening and closing theme (as many PD distributors did) before streaming. Other underscore cues are part of the lapsed film but may also exist as separately published music; treat as residual risk. Episodes from S2E20 onward and all later seasons are renewed/automatically renewed and are EXCLUDED. Paul Henning's estate holds the original elements; MPI releases of restored versions carry their own new-matter copyright, so only use independent prints such as these archive.org transfers.
